title: Not ideal for reclining loveseat
text:
Not ideal for reclining loveseat. There is too much extra fabric for loveseat recliner, which does not have “tuckable’ gaps between seat cushions or along arm. I have tried but cannot get a good fit. This slides all over the place. Constantly rearranging. Ideally there should be just enough material to lay flat across the cushions, from arm to arm. The arm flaps are also too long, making it difficult to use the sewn in pockets.
Good quality. Poor design.

For comparison: I am using this on an Ashley Signature Loveseat electric recliner, which has 2 seats that recline independently.
